text:
jess: Heads-up, Orchid Health reports ~10% of calls to /v1/generate either return 503 or hang (promise never resolves) when using our JS SDK. Started ~09:12 PST, eu-west1. They use streaming in the browser and see the connection stay open but no chunks and client never fires onend.

maya: Can you paste a sample request id and which SDK version?

jess: request_id=gh-20260317-4521, SDK 3.2.1 (browser). Repro steps they gave: 1) init Client(token) 2) call client.generate({model: 'rw-latest', stream: true, prompt}) 3) open ~12 concurrent streams -> some never resolve.

sam: Any edge logs? Stack traces? Does it correlate with backend 5xx or proxy resets?

jess: Pasted a short log snippet from their capture:
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/2 200
:status: 200
content-type: text/event-stream
--- then nothing for 45s ---
client: pending promise, no more chunks, no FIN
```

eli: A few known issues around HTTP/2 stream windowing and large chunked payloads can cause stuck streams in older SDKs. 3.2.1 still uses the eventsource polyfill in browsers which can hide connection resets. Can we repro internally with >10 concurrent streaming connections?

sam: I'll spin up a repro runner hitting eu-west1 with concurrency 16 to try to reproduce. If it's proxy-level (edge) we'll see 5xx or reset traces.

oncall-sre-bot: Alert: increased 504s observed in eu-west1 09:08-09:26, spike in downstream queue depth on edge-proxy-9. Incident INC-65721 created.

support-bot: Created INC-65721 and assigned to oncall SRE. Notifying customer that we are investigating. :white_check_mark:

jess: FYI I already told customer we've opened an incident and asked them to temporarily avoid long-lived streaming; asked for HAR and SDK logs.

sam: Repro run results: confirmed intermittent hanging streams under concurrent connections. Edge metrics show queue depth on a subset of proxies climbing and per-connection inflight streams hitting 65 (config is 64), which caused head-of-line blocking and prevented FIN from propagating. Also saw occasional upstream 502s when the upstream pod restarted.

amaya: So two issues: a proxy connection limit + upstream restarts. What's the mitigation?

sam: Short-term: 1) throttle client concurrency (advise customer to limit to <=8 concurrent streams) 2) deploy edge hotfix to drop excess streams early and ensure stuck streams are torn down after 30s. Pushing hotfix now.

eli: I'll draft an SDK patch to make streaming fall back to short-polling when it detects long time-to-first-chunk and expose a config flag maxConcurrentStreams. That should reduce customer-side impact for browsers.

oncall-sre-bot: Deploy started: edge-proxy-9 hotfix rollback + windowing patch. ETA ~7m.

jess: Sent customer: "We've identified edge queue pressure causing stuck streams under high concurrency. Temporary mitigations: limit concurrent streams to 8, or use non-streaming calls. We will deploy a server patch; we'll follow up when it's complete."

sam: Patch deployed at 09:35 PST. Edge now enforces per-connection max streams and aggressively tears down streams idle >30s. Monitoring shows queue depth returning to normal and 504 spike subsiding.

jess: Customer verified: after reducing concurrency and following our guidance, no more hung requests. They reported their app is healthy again.

eli: I'll open PR for SDK 3.2.3 with the maxConcurrentStreams config and better streaming fallback logic.

jess: Closing loop with customer and will update the status page after postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
